Definition
[Symmetric ideal prism] \group reflection-polyhedra Source: thurston:page-0179, thurston:page-0180

Let $\mathcal N_{\alpha ,\beta }$ be the polyhedron obtained by joining corresponding vertices of congruent regular ideal $n$-gons in two planes symmetrically. Its side faces meet the bases at angle $\alpha $, meet each other at angle $\beta $, and \[ 2\alpha +\beta =\pi . \]
